propositions: The deterministic half of E2 (mutant corpus, thresholds, benchmark harness seams, counting helpers, golden tests) was designed and built as WIP on branch calib/6982-e2 and is intentionally not landed on main because it only drives the rejected batch.

The expensive ~100-run LLM batch baseline (live gate sweep over mutant/control corpus) is permanently rejected on cost and superseded by the standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder from story d8a5, which accumulates the same detection and blocking-FP signal at zero marginal LLM cost.
History-based baseline mining is dead because only ~4 plan-v3 sidecar baselines exist versus ~200 needed due to the impact_model_version bump stranding the historical data.

The seeded-defect mutant corpus was built deterministically from cleanly-closed real plans with five defect classes (absent capability, layer-cake split, consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge, unnecessary mechanism, untagged operational AC), each paired with unmutated controls.
Store isolation is implemented by construction via standalone git clone with independent .git directory to prevent mutation commits from contaminating the real .tickets-tracker.
Run validity is enforced by emit_baseline guard with ≥0.20 INDETERMINATE cap, and counting helpers classify pair verdicts via multi-criteria set-intersection attribution.
